'''Ninjaguana''' is a [[Water]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Skinkoon]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Hychroma]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Stealth. Silence. Patience. Not everyone can master these arts. It takes years of extraordinary discipline and years of dedicated training. Hold on, are those two talking behind Ninjaguana's back'''―'''er, Ninjaguana's right here. Wait..."

Ninjaguana is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A bipedal, purple lizard with a bright cyan face and a white underbelly. Its irises and eyelids are blue. Its tail is as large as its body, purple- and cyan-colored, and is curled like a chameleon tail. Its hands are surrounded by spheres of water.

Ninjaguana's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] variant changes its purple spots to pink and reddish-purple instead.

== Evolution Trial ==
Ninjaguana's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Hychroma]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Raise this Tatari to B quality.
* TBA

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Ninjaguana is a part-time acupuncturist. Its ninjutsu hits your chakras and cools your body."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Dual-wielding water spheres with a ninja technique, Ninjuana conjures illusions to mislead foes and slips away unseen."
